message.reasoning_content: The process survived across the shell call? The pid 837918, PPID 837915 (setsid parent). ps shows it in this call. Now in a new call verify it's still running and curl it.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd \"$(pwd)\"; echo \"recorded pid=$(cat service.pid)\"; ps -o pid,ppid,stat,cmd -p \"$(cat service.pid)\" || echo \"NOT RUNNING\"; echo \"--- curl ---\"; curl -sS -D headers.txt -o service.txt -w 'http_code=%{http_code}\\ncontent_type=%{content_type}\\nsize_download=%{size_download}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health; echo \"curl_exit=$?\""}
